format: Every frame is MAVLink 2 (start byte 0xFD), unsigned, made by pymavlink from 'fields'.
A codec encodes 'fields' with the given sysid, compid and seq and must produce 'hex' byte for byte, including the MAVLink 2 truncation of trailing zero payload bytes (never below 1 byte).
A decoder must turn 'hex' into 'fields'. Missing payload bytes decode as zero.

Field values: integers as JSON numbers; char arrays as strings without the NUL padding; float fields as the double value of the float32, or "NaN"; 'float_bits' holds the exact IEEE 754 bits (big-endian hex) of every float field and wins over the number.
PARAM_VALUE frames carry 'value': byte-wise (PX4) reads the float bits as an int32; C cast (ArduPilot) reads the float as a number.
'layouts' gives each subset message in wire order with its CRC_EXTRA; 'extension' fields are MAVLink 2 extensions, outside the CRC_EXTRA calculation and after the base fields.
'bad_frames' are frames a decoder must skip; 'stream' is one buffer whose good frames must decode in the order of 'decodes'.
'extended_frames' carry more payload than the definitions here know (newer extension fields); a decoder must accept them, decode the listed fields and ignore the extra bytes. They are decode-only.

frames.name: heartbeat_gcs
frames.note: The phone's own heartbeat: MAV_TYPE_GCS, MAV_AUTOPILOT_INVALID.

frames.name: heartbeat_ardupilot_guided_armed
frames.note: ArduCopter in GUIDED, armed, flying.

frames.name: heartbeat_px4_mission_armed
frames.note: PX4 in AUTO.MISSION, armed: custom_mode packs main mode 4 in byte 2 and sub mode 4 in byte 3.

frames.name: sys_status
frames.note: Extension fields are zero, so the payload is truncated to 31 bytes.

frames.name: sys_status_battery_unknown
frames.note: battery_remaining -1 and voltage_battery UINT16_MAX mean unknown; a nonzero extension keeps 43 bytes.

frames.name: battery_status
frames.note: Battery 0, four cells reported; unused cells are UINT16_MAX.

frames.name: battery_status_second_pack
frames.note: A second battery instance; the phone reads instance 0 only.

frames.name: gps_raw_int
frames.note: 3D fix, 14 satellites; negative longitude.

frames.name: gps_raw_int_no_fix
frames.note: No fix: satellites_visible 255 means unknown.

frames.name: global_position_int
frames.note: relative_alt is millimetres above home; hdg is centidegrees.

frames.name: global_position_int_below_home_heading_unknown
frames.note: Negative relative_alt; hdg UINT16_MAX means unknown.

frames.name: home_position
frames.note: Home with an identity quaternion; time_usec (an extension) is zero, so the frame is truncated.

frames.name: extended_sys_state_in_air
frames.note: ArduCopter reports MAV_VTOL_STATE_MC (3); landed_state 2 is IN_AIR.

frames.name: extended_sys_state_on_ground
frames.note: PX4 multicopter: vtol_state 0, landed_state 1 is ON_GROUND.

frames.name: statustext_prearm
frames.note: Trailing zero bytes of the text are truncated from the payload; a decoder zero-fills them.

frames.name: statustext_full_50
frames.note: Exactly 50 characters: the text has no terminating NUL.

frames.name: command_long_arm
frames.note: MAV_CMD_COMPONENT_ARM_DISARM; confirmation 0 is the last byte, so it is truncated.

frames.name: command_long_set_message_interval
frames.note: MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL for GLOBAL_POSITION_INT at 5 Hz.

frames.name: command_long_px4_hold_retry
frames.note: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_MODE to PX4 AUTO.LOITER, second try (confirmation 1).

frames.name: command_long_land_third_try
frames.note: MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND, third try; sequence number 255 (the next frame wraps to 0).

frames.name: command_long_request_home
frames.note: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE for HOME_POSITION; sequence number 0 after the wrap.

frames.name: command_ack_accepted_ardupilot
frames.note: ArduCopter addresses the ACK to the sender (extension fields target_system and target_component).

frames.name: command_ack_denied_px4
frames.note: PX4 arm refused by its preflight checks: MAV_RESULT_DENIED.

frames.name: command_ack_no_target
frames.note: All extension fields zero: the payload is 3 bytes.

frames.name: param_request_read_by_name
frames.note: param_index -1 selects the name; trailing NULs of param_id are truncated.

frames.name: param_request_read_16_chars
frames.note: A 16-character name has no terminating NUL.

frames.name: param_value_ardupilot_int8
frames.note: ArduCopter: INT8 sent as a C cast to float; by-name reads echo index -1 (65535).

frames.name: param_value_ardupilot_real32
frames.note: ArduCopter REAL32.

frames.name: param_value_px4_int32_bytewise
frames.note: PX4: the int32 2 is copied byte-wise into the float field (a subnormal float).

frames.name: param_value_px4_int32_negative_bytewise
frames.note: Synthetic name. The int32 -1 byte-wise is the float bit pattern ffffffff, a NaN: a decoder must keep the bits and never canonicalise the NaN.

frames.name: param_value_px4_real32
frames.note: PX4 REAL32.

frames.name: param_error_does_not_exist
frames.note: ArduCopter 4.7.3 answers a read of an unknown name with MAV_PARAM_ERROR_DOES_NOT_EXIST.

frames.name: mission_count
frames.note: Upload start; mission_type 0 is MAV_MISSION_TYPE_MISSION.

frames.name: mission_request_ardupilot
frames.note: ArduCopter requests items with MISSION_REQUEST (40).

frames.name: mission_request_int_px4
frames.note: PX4 requests items with MISSION_REQUEST_INT (51).

frames.name: mission_item_int_home_placeholder
frames.note: ArduPilot sequence 0: the home placeholder.

frames.name: mission_item_int_takeoff
frames.note: NAV_TAKEOFF to 10 m relative to home; yaw NaN keeps the autopilot's heading behaviour.

frames.name: mission_item_int_waypoint
frames.note: NAV_WAYPOINT in MAV_FRAME_GLOBAL_RELATIVE_ALT.

frames.name: mission_item_int_change_speed
frames.note: DO_CHANGE_SPEED in MAV_FRAME_MISSION: ground speed 3 m/s, throttle unchanged.

frames.name: mission_item_int_return
frames.note: NAV_RETURN_TO_LAUNCH in MAV_FRAME_MISSION; mission_type 0 is truncated.

frames.name: mission_ack_accepted_px4
frames.note: Upload accepted. PX4 1.17 appends opaque_id (a newer extension); see 'extended_frames'.

frames.name: mission_ack_no_space_ardupilot
frames.note: MAV_MISSION_NO_SPACE.

frames.name: mission_current_full
frames.note: Current item 3 of 7, mission active.

frames.name: mission_current_seq_only
frames.note: Only seq set: the payload is truncated to 1 byte, and a decoder zero-fills the rest.

frames.name: autopilot_version_ardupilot
frames.note: ArduCopter 4.6.3, official (type byte 255).

frames.name: autopilot_version_px4
frames.note: PX4 1.17.0; uid2 set, so the frame is not truncated.

bad_frames.name: truncated
bad_frames.skip: the buffer ends inside the frame

bad_frames.name: unknown_message
bad_frames.skip: message id 50001 is not in the subset, so its checksum cannot be checked: produce nothing and resume the search at the next byte

bad_frames.name: signed
bad_frames.skip: incompat flag 0x01 (signed): produce nothing; v1 links are unsigned

bad_frames.name: unknown_incompat_flag
bad_frames.skip: an incompat flag the codec does not know: drop the frame (MAVLink 2 rule)

bad_frames.name: mavlink1
bad_frames.skip: MAVLink 1 frame (0xFE); v1 speaks MAVLink 2 only

extended_frames.name: mission_ack_accepted_px4_extended
extended_frames.note: MISSION_ACK with PX4's opaque_id (mission checksum) appended.

extended_frames.name: mission_current_full_extended
extended_frames.note: MISSION_CURRENT with mission_id, fence_id and rally_points_id appended.

stream.note: Garbage, a bad checksum, a signed frame, an unknown message and a truncated frame sit between good frames. After any frame it cannot accept the parser resumes its search at the byte after that 0xFD (never skipping a length it could not verify), so the truncated frame costs no good frame.
